action_items: NONE (blocking): Feature is production-ready. 7/7 pick_upgrades + 23 regression tests pass; 4 conditional buttons + per-action THEN UI verified live.
critical_code_review_comments: TradePickUpgrade model correctly makes new_round Optional — required for action='add'/'remove' where round rewrite is N/A.

_apply_pick_upgrades branches cleanly on action ('rewrite' | 'add' | 'remove') — each emits the right trade_history kind ('pick_upgrade' / 'pick_added' / 'pick_removed') and matching audit_log action with result='pass'.
applied_at flag on trade.pick_upgrades[i] guarantees idempotency — re-toggling championship returns pick_upgrades_applied=0, asserted in test.
PickUpgradeEditor.tsx 'window.__addPickUpgrade(direction)' bridge correctly maps direction → action: upgrade/downgrade → 'rewrite', add → 'add', remove → 'remove'.
From/To-team selectors only rendered for action != 'rewrite' — keeps rewrite UI uncluttered and prevents invalid payloads.
Badge labels use direction (not action) so 'upgrade' vs 'downgrade' are distinguishable to users even though both serialize as action='rewrite'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 4 conditional buttons, 4 badges, conditional THEN UI for both rewrite + add/remove
